levels.surface: حميد بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف

notes: Marwan's message to Ibn Abbas goes through a messenger (addressed as «يا رافع»); the messenger is not a route. Ibn Abbas answers and his reply is the saying, so he is linked after Marwan
«قال ابن جريج» is the speaker who relays Ibn Abi Mulayka (kept as the link)
